title: About SmartAIIntel
body:
SmartAIIntel is an independently operated news publication covering the United States and world affairs, security, technology, business and sports.

The publication is run by its owner, with contributing writers covering their respective subject areas. Articles are checked by the owner and relevant subject-area reviewers before publication.

Our aim is to give readers clear reporting and useful context. Our editorial standards explain how we handle sources, corrections and occasional AI assistance.

For editorial enquiries, contact bloggerinvitro@gmail.com.

title: Contact
body:
For editorial enquiries, feedback or correction requests, email **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com**.

For a correction, include the article title or link, the passage you believe is inaccurate, and supporting information or a reliable source where available.

Please do not send passwords, financial details or other sensitive personal information. Email is handled through Gmail and is subject to that service's applicable terms and privacy practices. We cannot guarantee a particular response time.

title: Editorial & Corrections Policy
body:
### Editorial responsibility
SmartAIIntel is independently operated. Contributing writers prepare articles in their subject areas. The owner and relevant subject-area reviewers check material before publication. Publication responsibility remains with SmartAIIntel, including when AI tools assist with an article.

### Sources and verification
We check factual claims against reliable sources and prefer original documents, official records and direct statements where available. We attribute information and quotations, link to supporting material where practical, and distinguish established facts from allegations, estimates and uncertainty. We do not invent quotations, sources or credentials.

### Reporting, analysis and opinion
Opinion and analysis should be clearly labelled. Headlines must fairly represent the article. Unconfirmed claims must not be presented as established facts.

### AI assistance
Our writers primarily write and review articles manually. AI tools are sometimes used to help draft or edit material. Human editors must check facts, quotations, references and context before publication; AI output is not itself a source. Where AI has a substantial role in producing an article or an illustrative image, we will provide an appropriate disclosure. We will not present AI-generated imagery as a photograph of a real event.

### Corrections and updates
We review credible reports of errors and correct verified inaccuracies. Material factual corrections will carry a clear note explaining what changed. Routine spelling or formatting fixes may be made without a separate note. Updates that add new information will be distinguished from corrections when the distinction matters.

To request a correction, email **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com** with the article link, the disputed passage and relevant evidence. We do not guarantee a particular response time.

### Attribution and rights
Articles carry the responsible writer's byline. We use text, photographs and other materials only where we have permission, an appropriate licence, or another lawful basis. Required credits and licence notices must be retained.

### Independence and conflicts
Contributors must disclose relevant conflicts to the editor. Sponsored or paid editorial material, if accepted, must be clearly labelled and must not be presented as independent reporting. Advertising must be visually distinguishable from editorial content.

title: Privacy Policy
body:
## Who operates this website
SmartAIIntel is an independently operated publication run by its owner with contributing writers. For privacy questions or requests, contact **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com**.

## Information processed when you visit
The new website is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Hosting and security services may process technical information such as IP addresses, requested URLs, browser information, timestamps and security events to deliver and protect the website. Cloudflare processes information under its applicable terms and privacy practices. See https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/ .

Cloudflare Web Analytics is disabled for this project. We have not configured Google Analytics on the new site. This does not mean that hosting and security systems process no information.

## When you contact us
If you email us, we receive your email address, message and any information or attachments you provide. We use this information to respond, investigate corrections or editorial enquiries, and maintain relevant correspondence. Messages are handled through Gmail, provided by Google. See https://policies.google.com/privacy . Please do not send passwords, financial details or unnecessary sensitive information.

## Cookies, analytics and advertising
No visitor analytics, advertising code or third-party football widget is intentionally included in the reviewed new-site build. We have not configured Google Analytics, and Cloudflare Web Analytics is disabled. Infrastructure or security features may behave differently from the site's own code; we do not promise that every visit is entirely free of cookies or technical identifiers.

This policy describes the new SmartAIIntel website hosted on Cloudflare Pages. It does not describe the previous website hosting.

We will update this policy and implement applicable privacy choices before enabling advertising, analytics or additional third-party embedded services on the new site.

## How information is used and shared
We use information to deliver and secure the website, respond to enquiries, assess correction requests, and meet applicable legal obligations. Hosting and email providers process information needed for their services. We may also disclose information when required by law or where necessary to address security incidents or protect legal rights. We do not sell information submitted through editorial enquiries.

## Retention
We keep correspondence only for as long as reasonably needed for its purpose, including resolving enquiries, documenting corrections and meeting applicable obligations. Technical records held by service providers are subject to their service arrangements and retention practices. This policy does not promise a fixed deletion period that we cannot verify.

## International processing
Our hosting and email providers may process information in countries other than your own. Their applicable privacy notices describe their international processing and safeguards.

## Your choices and requests
Depending on the law that applies to you, you may have rights relating to access, correction, deletion, objection or other handling of your personal information. Email **bloggerinvitro@gmail.com** to make a request. We may need information to verify your request. Applicable exceptions or obligations may affect what we can delete or provide. You may also have a right to complain to the relevant data protection authority.

## External links
Articles may link to other websites. Following a link takes you to a separate service whose privacy practices apply. A link is not an assurance about that service's practices.

## Changes
We will revise this policy when the site's processing changes and show an effective or updated date when the policy is published. Where required, we will provide additional notice or seek consent.
